text: {"question":"How does the coupling parameter ξ in the TG scalar‑tensor model influence the ability of generalized PAge (GPAge) parameterizations to alleviate the Hubble tension, and what observational constraints must be considered to test this combined approach?","reference_answer":"The coupling ξ controls the magnitude of Planck‑mass variations in the early universe, which in turn determines the background expansion history that GPAge parameterizations must reproduce.
